title: Proven-Arrangement Months for Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Payment Arrangements
content:
**Questions and answers on the proven-arrangement months of a new Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility payment arrangement.**

**What earns proven-arrangement months?** A completed earlier arrangement on the coverage account: the account's payment-arrangement status shows completed, and the arrangement's start date is on the record. The months are added to the term of the new arrangement.

**How many?**

| The account's arrangement record | Months added |
|---|---|
| status completed, start date no more than 36 whole calendar months before the handling date | 2 |
| status completed, start date more than 36 whole calendar months before the handling date | 1 |
| any other status (none, active, defaulted) | 0 |

**Boundary (hypothetical).** A completed arrangement that started 36 whole months before the handling date adds 2 months; one that started 37 whole months before adds 1.

**Does a defaulted arrangement count?** No — only a completed arrangement adds months.
